description: Tinker is Thinking Machines Lab's API for LoRA training and sampling across open-weight text, vision, and audio-capable models. Separate OpenAI-compatible serverless inference for Inkling models is in beta.
prompt_training_notes: Thinking Machines says customer data is used solely to fine-tune customer models and is not used to train its own models.
regional_pricing_notes: Thinking Machines publishes one global USD rate card; no region-specific prices or execution/data-residency regions are documented.

sources.notes: Authoritative model, pricing, context, modality, lifecycle and beta availability tables.
Official product scope and no-training-on-customer-data statement.

verification.notes: All 25 active or scheduled-to-retire training/sampling variants and both serverless beta variants reconciled against official machine-readable feeds; no public rate limits or region/residency guarantees are documented.
